messages:
Tara (PM): Quick review request for the compact compare iteration I uploaded. Main asks: make perf badges screen-reader friendly, confirm pin scope wording, and ensure keyboard-first discoverability for 'show pinned when filtered'. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-compare-iter2

Maya (Design): Noted. I replaced color-only badges with an icon + label (e.g., ⚡ Latency P95 — 120ms) and added a microtrend arrow. For small widths I collapse tags into an overflow chevron. Tooltip copy options: 'Pinned v3 — default compare' or 'Default for compare: v3'. Thoughts?

Ibrahim D.: Backend: currently pins reference alias. We should store immutable version_id to avoid surprise flips during rollouts. Adding a scope field (user|workspace) is straightforward. Migration plan: backfill version_id when alias maps to a single version, otherwise flag for manual review. Also will emit audit events when workspace pins change.

Keon (Eng): A11y consideration: when a user pins/unpins, we should update a live region so screen readers hear "Pinned model v3 set as default for compare." Use aria-live=polite. Also ensure the pin action is reachable by keyboard (Enter/Space) and that the pin button has aria-pressed and aria-describedby linking to scope hint text.

A11y-Bot: Scan: contrast issues on light orange badge bg; recommend darker glyph color or full-contrast label. Table headers need aria-sort; rows should include aria-rowindex. Live region present? Not yet in mock. Recommend keyboard focus order: row -> actions -> pin control -> menu.

Maya (Design): For the 'show pinned when filtered out' flow, I mocked a compact banner: "Pinned model hidden by filters — Show anyway" with a keyboard-focusable button and an explanatory tooltip. When clicked it scrolls the pinned row into view and gives it a subtle highlight. For screen-reader users the button should announce count like "Show pinned model (1)".

Ibrahim D.: Implementation detail: if pinned model doesn't match current filter, we can still show it but tag it with a 'filter mismatch' badge. Cache invalidation: we'll emit pin.invalidate.<org> for workspace scope.

Keon (Eng): On the pin scope wording: prefer 'Set default for compare' as primary CTA and a small secondary selector 'Scope: Only me / Workspace (requires permission)'. Workspace option disabled until backend support is live; tooltip explains why. We'll add a confirmation modal when escalating to workspace scope.

Tara (PM): Decisions: 1) Store version_id for pins (Ibrahim to spec migration). 2) Default pin scope = personal; show workspace option disabled in UI until API ready. 3) Add aria-live message for pin actions and aria-describedby for pin scope. 4) Replace color-only badges with icon+label and ensure numeric values are readable by screen readers. Maya/Keon please iterate Figma and share a11y annotation by EOD Fri.

Maya (Design): Will do. I'll include the live-region copy and tab order notes in the Figma file.

Ibrahim D.: I'll post a short schema diff and migration notes by Thu.

Keon (Eng): I'll add the small front-end acceptance tests for keyboard nav + aria attributes.

Tara (PM): Thanks all — booking a 20min follow-up Fri 11:30 to confirm. :calendar:
